blog.desc: Method guides I write to explain AI, agents and automation. They rely on typical scenarios, not client engagements.
blog.line.title: What you will find here, and what you won't
blog.line.p1.title: Method before tools
blog.line.p1.desc: Each article explains an architecture choice, its trade-offs and its limits, to help you decide, not to sell you a tool.
blog.line.p2.title: Typical scenarios, never fake results
blog.line.p2.desc: Examples are scenarios built to illustrate the method. No client figure is published unless it has been measured and approved.
blog.line.p3.title: Grounded in what I build
blog.line.p3.desc: The principles described here are the ones I apply in my own projects: Ciblioo, ContentOps Harness and AVIE.
